recommendation: Keep this fix. Handle any additional Observation documentation or example work through FHIR-57447 or another final OO/PC decision; do not restore Goal.outcome without a new decision reversing FHIR-37262/FHIR-48360.
issue_request: FHIR-37262 asked to add more resource targets to Goal.outcome. Patient Care resolved the Applied issue as Not Persuasive with Modification: remove Goal.outcome and use the resource-pertainsToGoal extension instead.

additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-53828 and FHIR-48360 decisions continue to favor resource-pertainsToGoal rather than restoring Goal.outcome. The replacement extension is defined in the FHIR Extension Pack; FHIR-57447 is an unresolved OO follow-up for Observation-side documentation and was not decided.
